featured_reviews.name: Ankit Chaurasiya
featured_reviews.review_text: If u want to get your adhaar card updated or make a new you can go here on the 2 nd floor and get your work done. The best time to visit this place is 9 am in the morning to get the form and stand in the queue after filling up this form. If you live in  any other town or city you can travel by train and from station you can go by auto rickshaw. The autorickshaw driver would take only 20 rupees by sharing and 60 rupees by alone. You have to just tell that i want to go at hawai pada naka and the driver will drop you off. From there you ca go 3 min walking and you will be on your destination. There will be one agent sitting outside the room and 1 wil be inside making the aadhaar. You will be charged 100 rupees for aadhar update and more than 300 for new aadhar card. You will get fast service for your problem only go there with your proper documents.
